results.intentUsed: This page estimates shipping and discounts for a $42.00 cart. Work through these checks in order and record exactly what you observe for each: 1. results.intentUsed: This is a 3-step onboarding wizard. Work through these checks in order and record exactly what you observe for each: 1. On step 1 press Continue with everything empty and confirm each required field shows an error. 2. Enter an email with NO dot in the domain, for example sam@example (plus a valid workspace name and display name), press Continue, and record whether the wizard accepts it — a malformed email must be rejected. 3. The run explicitly reports that clicking Remove note 2 removed the last note, gamma, rather than the clicked second note, beta.
